summary: 一部古罗马日常生活史的作者解释为何要限定研究年代，并把地点聚焦在罗马城。文学记录的保存情况、城乡生活差异和城市环境，都决定了日常作息可以怎样重建。
logic: 说明文学记录提供的条件
先重建环境再考察日常作息

paragraphs.brief: 日常生活研究必须划定年代
sentences: If our ideas on Roman life are not to become lost in confusion, we must study it within a strictly defined time.
要避免对罗马生活的认识陷入混乱，研究必须限定在一个明确的时期。
Nothing changes more rapidly than human customs.
几乎没有什么比人的风俗习惯变化得更快。

Looking at our own more familiar world, apart from the great scientific discoveries of recent centuries which have turned it upside down—steam, electricity, railways, motor cars and aeroplanes, for example—it is clear that the elementary forms of everyday life have been subject to increasing change.
看看我们较熟悉的世界，即便撇开近几个世纪改变世界的蒸汽动力、电力、铁路、汽车和飞机等重大发现，日常生活最基本的形式也一直在加速变化。

Potatoes, for example, were not introduced into Europe until the sixteenth century, coffee was first drunk there in the late sixteenth or early seventeenth, and the banana was used in desserts in Europe at the beginning of the twentieth.
例如，马铃薯直到十六世纪才传入欧洲，欧洲人到十六世纪末或十七世纪初才开始喝咖啡，到二十世纪初才把香蕉用于甜点。
The law of change was not less operative in antiquity.
这种变化规律在古代同样适用。
It was a commonplace of Roman rhetoric to contrast the crude simplicity of the Republic (509BC–27BC) with the luxury and refinement of the imperial times which followed.
罗马人常在论述中将共和时代（公元前509年至前27年）的粗朴简约，与随后帝国时期的奢华精致作对照。
There is no common measure, whether of home, or house, or furniture, between ages which are so different.
不论是家庭生活、住房还是家具，这些迥异的时代都不能用同一把尺子衡量。
paragraphs.gist: 连饮食习惯都会随时代改变，共和时期的朴素生活与帝国时期的奢华也相去甚远，研究罗马日常生活必须先划定年代。

paragraphs.brief: 帝国全盛时期的一代人
sentences: Since a choice of time must necessarily be made, this history will confine itself to studying the generation which was born about the middle of the first century AD, toward the end of the reign of Claudius (41–54AD) or the beginning of the reign of Nero (54–68AD), and which lived on into the reign of Trajan (98–117AD) or of Hadrian (117–138AD).
既然必须确定年代，本书便选取公元一世纪中叶、即克劳狄乌斯统治末期（公元41—54年）或尼禄统治初期（54—68年）出生，而生活延续到图拉真（98—117年）或哈德良（117—138年）时期的一代人。
This generation saw the Roman Empire at its most powerful and prosperous.
这一代人亲眼见证了罗马帝国最强盛、最富庶的时代。

It was witness to the last conquests of the Caesars: the conquest of Dacia, in modern-day eastern Europe, which brought vast mineral wealth into the Empire, and the conquest of Arabia, which helped to bring the riches of India and East Asia flooding into Rome.
他们见证了罗马皇帝们最后的征服：今天东欧的达契亚给帝国带来丰厚矿产，而征服阿拉伯则使印度和东亚的财富大量流入罗马。
In the material domain, this generation attained the pinnacle of ancient civilisation.
在物质领域，这一代人达到了古代文明的最高境界。
paragraphs.gist: 作者选取公元一世纪中叶出生的一代，他们亲历帝国全盛时期，达契亚的矿产和经阿拉伯流入的东方财富支撑了物质繁荣。

paragraphs.brief: 文献与遗址共同还原生活
sentences: By a fortunate coincidence—all the more fortunate in that Latin* literature was soon to run nearly dry—this generation is the one whose records combine to offer us the most complete picture of Roman life that we possess.
幸运的是，正是这一代人的各类记录拼成了我们今天所能获得的最完整的罗马生活图景，何况此后拉丁文学很快就几近枯竭。
We have a profusion of vivid and picturesque descriptions, precise and colourful, in such works as the Epigrams of Martial, the Satires of Juvenal and the Letters of Pliny.
马提亚尔的《短诗集》、尤维纳利斯的《讽刺诗》和小普林尼的《书信集》等作品，留下了大量精确、生动而富有色彩的描写。

In addition, the Forum of Trajan in Rome itself and the ruins of Herculaneum and Pompeii, the two prosperous resorts buried by the eruption of Mount Vesuvius in 79AD, supply an immense fund of archaeological evidence.
此外，罗马城内的图拉真广场，以及公元79年维苏威火山喷发掩埋的两座繁荣度假城赫库兰尼姆与庞贝，都提供了大量考古证据。

Later excavations have also restored to us the ruins of the city of Ostia, which date in the main from the time when the Emperor Hadrian created this great commercial city as a realisation of his town planning ideas.
后来的发掘又揭示了奥斯提亚城遗址，其中大部分可追溯到哈德良皇帝为实践城市规划理想而建设这座商业大城的时代。
Fortune has favoured the historian of this time.
研究这一时期的历史学家实属幸运。
paragraphs.gist: 这一代人留下了翔实的书信与文学描写，庞贝等遗址和奥斯提亚的发掘又补充了实物证据，共同勾勒出格外完整的生活图景。

paragraphs.brief: 古代城乡差距与利益冲突
sentences: It is not enough to focus our study of Roman life only on a fixed time.
仅仅将我们对罗马生活的研究集中在固定的时间是不够的。
It would lack foundation and consistency if we did not also focus it in space—in the country or in the town.
如果不同时选定空间范围，即研究乡村还是城市，论述就会缺乏立足点和连贯性。

Even today when the facilities for communication bring something of the city into the smallest and most isolated country cottage, there remains a significant difference between rural existence and the excitement of city life: a much greater gulf separated the peasant from the townsman of antiquity.
即便今天交通通信能把部分城市生活带到最偏远的村舍，乡村与繁华都市的生活仍有明显差异；古代农民与市民之间的鸿沟还要深得多。

So large was the inequality between them that, according to the historian Rostovtzeff, it pitted one against the other in a fierce and silent struggle which pierced the wall protecting the Roman privileged classes from the barbarian flood from the north.
据历史学家罗斯托夫采夫所说，巨大的不平等使双方陷入激烈而无声的斗争，打破了罗马特权阶层抵御北方大批入侵者的屏障。
When the barbarian forces began to invade Roman territory, the peasants decided to fight alongside them.
当北方入侵者进入罗马领土时，农民决定与他们并肩作战。
paragraphs.gist: 除年代外还须选定城乡范围，因为古罗马农民与城市居民的鸿沟极深，北方势力入侵时甚至有农民站到了入侵者一边。

paragraphs.brief: 把研究对象限定为首都居民
sentences: The townsman, in fact, enjoyed all the goods and resources of the earth.
城市居民实际上享有世上的各种物资与资源。

The peasant knew nothing but unending labour without profit, and was unable to enjoy the activities available in even the poorest of cities: the liveliness of the sports field, the warmth of the public baths and the magnificence of public spectacles.
农民终年辛劳却无利可得，连最贫穷的城市都有的热闹运动场、温暖公共浴场和壮观公共表演，他们也无从享受。
In a work on the history of everyday life, we must give up any attempt to blend two such dissimilar pictures into one, and must choose between them.
在关于日常生活历史的著作中，我们必须放弃任何将两个不同画面混为一谈的企图，并且必须在两者之间作出选择。

The time which we have chosen to describe day by day is that of those Roman subjects who spent their time exclusively in the town, or rather in The City, Rome, which they regarded as the hub and centre of the universe, proud and wealthy ruler of a world which seemed at that time to have been pacified for ever.
我们选择描述的是那些始终居住于城市、更确切地说是首都罗马的臣民每天怎样生活；在他们眼里，罗马是宇宙的中心，是当时仿佛已永远平定的世界中富有而自豪的统治者。
paragraphs.gist: 农民终年劳作却无缘运动场、浴场和公共表演，作者因此专写首都居民，考察他们如何在自己心目中的世界中心度过每一天。

paragraphs.brief: 先还原空间、阶层与道德背景
sentences: To perform our task well, we must first try to form an adequate picture of the surroundings in which our subjects lived, and by which their lives were coloured, freeing ourselves from any misconceptions concerning it.
要完成这项工作，首先必须准确了解研究对象身处怎样的环境、生活如何受其影响，并摆脱成见。
We must seek to reconstruct the physical nature of the great city and the social milieu of the various classes of the hierarchy by which it was governed.
我们必须重建这座大城的实际面貌，以及构成其统治等级体系的不同阶层所处的社会环境。
We must also investigate the moral background of thought and sentiment which can help explain both its strength and its weaknesses.
我们还须考察当地思想和情感的道德背景，这有助于解释这座城市的长处与弱点。

The way in which the Romans of Rome employed their time can only be studied satisfactorily after we have plotted out the main lines of the framework within which they lived and outside of which the routine of their daily life would be more or less unintelligible.
只有先勾勒出罗马城居民所处的整体生活框架，才能真正研究他们如何分配时间；离开这个框架，其日常作息几乎无法理解。
paragraphs.gist: 要读懂罗马人的日常安排，得先重建城市空间、支配城市的阶层关系，以及能解释这个社会优点与弱点的道德观念和情感背景。

items.en: What does the writer say about the period mentioned in the second paragraph?
items.zh: 作者对第二段中提到的时期有什么看法？
correct: The Roman standard of living reached its highest level.
罗马人的生活水平在这一时期达到顶峰。

items.zh: 作者提到奥斯提亚，是将它作为哪一类地方的例子？
correct: an important area for archaeological research.
对考古研究十分重要的遗址。

items.en: The statement that ‘Fortune has favoured the historian of this time’ refers to the fact that
items.zh: 作者说“研究这个时期的历史学家很幸运”，指的是什么？
correct: a wide range of sources is available for this period.
这个时期留下了种类丰富的史料。

items.en: In comparing urban and rural life in the Roman Empire, the writer states that
items.zh: 在比较罗马帝国的城市和农村生活时，作者指出：
correct: rural life and urban life had little in common.
农村生活和城市生活几乎没有共同之处。

items.en: Rome’s conquest of Arabia resulted in large-scale immigration from the east into Rome.
items.zh: 罗马征服阿拉伯后，大批移民从东方迁入罗马。
items.why: 征服阿拉伯使印度和东亚的财富流入罗马，作者说的是财富和物资。文中没有说明来自东方的移民人数有没有大幅增加。

items.en: More can be learned about Roman life from the literature of the period studied in this book than from later Latin literature.
items.zh: 与后世的拉丁文学相比，本书所研究时期的文学作品更能帮助我们了解罗马人的生活。
items.why: 与题干一致: 该时期文献最完整、后期文献衰竭，因此能学到更多。

items.en: Discoveries at Herculaneum and Pompeii showed that certain beliefs about Roman life were wrong.
items.zh: 赫库兰尼姆和庞贝的考古发现推翻了人们对罗马生活的某些看法。
items.why: 赫库兰尼姆和庞贝的遗迹提供了丰富的考古资料。作者没有说这些发现具体推翻了哪些关于古罗马生活的旧看法。

items.en: Roman peasants provided assistance to the Empire when it was attacked.
items.zh: 罗马农民在帝国遭到攻击时向其提供援助。
items.why: 外敌入侵罗马领土时，农民选择和入侵者并肩作战。题干把他们援助的一方从入侵者换成了罗马帝国。

items.en: Rural inhabitants of the Roman Empire had a difficult life.
items.zh: 罗马帝国的农村居民生活艰难。
items.why: 原文说农民终日劳作而难有收益，还无法享受城镇居民拥有的公共生活设施，具体描写了农村生活的艰辛。

items.en: Entertainment facilities were limited to the city of Rome itself.
items.zh: 只有罗马城本身才有娱乐设施。
items.why: 即使是最贫穷的城市也有运动场、公共浴场和演出，因此这些娱乐设施并不限于罗马城。

groups.label: 观点判断 · YES / NO / NOT GIVEN

items.en: The scope of the writer’s study It was important for the writer to limit several aspects of his ________.
items.zh: 作者研究古罗马人的日常生活时，需要从几个方面限定其 ________ 的范围。
items.why: “限制多个方面指对研究/调查范围的限定 (时间与空间两个维度),用 investigation 最贴切。

items.en: He decided to focus on a limited ________ in Roman history, and to concentrate on the section of the population who were ____ (Q39).
items.zh: 他决定只考察罗马历史中的一个特定 ________，并将研究对象限定为 ________（Q39） 这一人群。
items.why: 直接对应“限定一个时期/时间段"。

items.en: He decided to focus on a limited ____ (Q38) in Roman history, and to concentrate on the section of the population who were ________.
items.zh: 他决定只考察罗马历史中的一个特定 ________（Q38），并将研究对象限定为 ________ 这一人群。
items.why: 明确选择城居者而非农民。

items.en: The writer was interested in the physical environment, the people that ruled the country and the ________ that contributed both to Rome’s strength and to its weaknesses.
items.zh: 作者感兴趣的是当地的物质环境、统治者，以及既造就罗马的强大也导致其弱点的 ________。
items.why: “moral background of thought and sentiment"c 价值观、观念体系，且与“强弱” 双向相关，故选 values。

groups.label: 选词填空
groups.instructionsZh: 阅读带空格的中译，回想正确词项及其字母。

pairs: 第 3 段 · 第 3 句
第 1 段 · 第 7 句
第 5 段 · 第 2 句
points: 即使是最贫穷的城市也有运动场、公共浴场和演出，因此这些娱乐设施并不限于罗马城。
“限制多个方面指对研究/调查范围的限定 (时间与空间两个维度),用 investigation 最贴切。
clauses: …, we must study it within a strictly defined time.
连接词 if 引出“If our ideas on Roman life are not to become lost in confusion”，说明主句的条件关系。
先读主句的动作，再用 if 把这一层关系补进去。

The time … is that of those Roman subjects who spent their time exclusively in the town, or rather in The City, Rome, which they regarded as the hub and centre of the universe, proud and wealthy ruler of a world which seemed at that time to have been pacified for ever.
“which we have chosen to describe day by day”修饰前面的 time。先认出先行词，再读从句补充的特征。
读到 which 时，回看 time，再把修饰信息接回主句。
lead: In this preface to a history, the writer explains the factors affecting the scope of his study.
在这本历史著作的序言中，作者解释了自己划定研究范围时考虑的因素。
